cross_article_review.observation: Curtailment-based compute investment planning and semiconductor fab utility performance share energy economics but customers and core decisions differ; not automatically merge.
Crowdsourced data QA and preventing autonomous agent form submissions have distinct actors, jobs and controls; not automatically merge.
Existing 91-record catalogue already includes data-centre permit and transparency products; a renamed Oakville permit desk should not republish.

method_notes: Original publisher page unresolved means no fully verified claim, irrespective of news feed title.
Some original publisher search results did not open; such records explicitly retain the error.
This is a non-worker supplemental research artifact, not an official discovery receipt.
No primary Turkish competitor mapping or global exhaustive direct competitor test completed; all counts remain null.
AI music human-authorship evidence has at least one likely global direct incumbent: RightsDocket.
All 91 existing catalog entries left unchanged; no jobs, claims, receipts, worker settings or state files changed.
